323	// buildReplacer creates a strings.Replacer that rewrites llama-server model name aliases

326		aliases := g.rt.backendAliases[backendName]
327		var pairs []string
328		for _, alias := range aliases {
329			if alias == backendName {
330				continue
331			}
332			pairs = append(pairs,
333				`"model":"`+alias+`"`, `"model":"`+backendName+`"`,

342	// replacingReader wraps an io.Reader and applies a strings.Replacer to each chunk read.
343	// Overflow bytes (when replacement expands the chunk) are buffered internally.
344	type replacingReader struct {
345		r    io.Reader
346		repl *strings.Replacer
347		buf  bytes.Buffer
348	}
349	
350	func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
351		if rr.buf.Len() > 0 {
352			return rr.buf.Read(p)
353		}
354		tmp := make([]byte, len(p))
355		n, readErr := rr.r.Read(tmp)
356		if n > 0 {
357			replaced := []byte(rr.repl.Replace(string(tmp[:n])))
358			copy(p, replaced)
359			if len(replaced) > len(p) {
360				rr.buf.Write(replaced[len(p):])
361				return len(p), nil // defer readErr until buf is drained
362			}
363			return len(replaced), readErr
364		}
365		return 0, readErr
366	}

372		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{ //nolint:errcheck
373			"error": map[string]any{
374				"message": message,
375				"type":    errType,
376				"code":    code,
377			},
378		})

183		for {

215		m := &BackendMetrics{Name: b.Name}

227		} else {

267	// itoa converts an int to its decimal string representation without importing
268	// the strconv package at the call site.
269	func itoa(n int) string {
270		if n == 0 {
271			return "0"
272		}
273		neg := n < 0
274		if neg {
275			n = -n
276		}
277		buf := make([]byte, 0, 10)
278		for n > 0 {
279			buf = append([]byte{byte('0' + n%10)}, buf...)
280			n /= 10
281		}
282		if neg {
283			buf = append([]byte{'-'}, buf...)
284		}
285		return string(buf)
286	}

64	func (g *Gateway) ListenAndServe(ctx context.Context) error {

66		go func() {

81	// handleRoute extracts the model field from the JSON body and proxies to the matching backend.
82	func (g *Gateway) handleRoute(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
83		if len(g.cfg.Backends) == 0 {
84			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "no backends configured", "no_backends")
85			return
86		}
87	
88		// Tee the body so the decoder and the upstream both see it.
89		var captured bytes.Buffer
90		tee := io.TeeReader(r.Body, &captured)
91		dec := json.NewDecoder(tee)
92	
93		var payload struct {
94			Model string `json:"model"`
95		}
96		if err := dec.Decode(&payload); err != nil {
97			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "invalid JSON: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
98			return
99		}
100		if payload.Model == "" {
101			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "missing model field", "bad_request")
102			return
103		}
104	
105		// Reconstruct full body: captured bytes (read by decoder) + rest not yet read.
106		r.Body = io.NopCloser(io.MultiReader(&captured, r.Body))
107	
108		backendName, err := g.rt.resolve(payload.Model)
109		if err != nil {
110			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", err.Error(), "model_not_found")
111			return
112		}
113	
114		if !g.mgr.Healthy(backendName) {
115			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
116			return
117		}
118	
119		addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(backendName)
120		if !ok {
121			writeError(w, http.StatusServiceUnavailable, "server_error", "backend unavailable", "backend_unavailable")
122			return
123		}
124	
125		backend := g.cfg.Backends[backendName]
126		if backend.Provider == "anthropic" {
127			g.handleAnthropicProxy(w, r, backendName, backend, addr)
128			return
129		}
130	
131		target, parseErr := url.Parse(addr)
132		if parseErr != nil {
133			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "invalid backend URL", "internal_error")
134			return
135		}
136	
137		rewriter := g.buildReplacer(backendName)
138	
139		proxy := &httputil.ReverseProxy{
140			Rewrite: func(pr *httputil.ProxyRequest) {
141				pr.SetURL(target)
142				pr.Out.Host = target.Host
143			},
144			FlushInterval: -1,
145			ModifyResponse: func(resp *http.Response) error {
146				if rewriter != nil {
147					resp.Header.Del("Content-Length")
148					resp.ContentLength = -1
149					resp.Body = io.NopCloser(&replacingReader{r: resp.Body, repl: rewriter})
150				}
151				return nil
152			},
153			ErrorHandler: func(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request, err error) {
154				g.log.Error("proxy error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
155				writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
156			},
157		}

159		proxy.ServeHTTP(w, r)

162	// handleAnthropicProxy translates the OpenAI-format request to Anthropic Messages API format,
163	// proxies it directly (without httputil.ReverseProxy), and translates the response back.
164	func (g *Gateway) handleAnthropicProxy(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, backendName string, backend config.Backend, addr string) {
165		body, err := io.ReadAll(r.Body)
166		if err != nil {
167			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "failed to read body", "bad_request")
168			return
169		}
170	
171		// Determine whether the client wants a streaming response.
172		var meta struct {
173			Stream bool `json:"stream"`
174		}
175		json.Unmarshal(body, &meta) //nolint:errcheck
176	
177		// model is either the configured model name (managed) or the backend name (external).
178		model := backend.Model
179		if model == "" {
180			model = backendName
181		}
182	
183		antBody, err := anthropic.TranslateRequest(body, model)
184		if err != nil {
185			writeError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "invalid_request_error", "translation failed: "+err.Error(), "bad_request")
186			return
187		}
188	
189		antURL := strings.TrimRight(addr, "/") + "/v1/messages"
190		antReq, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(r.Context(), http.MethodPost, antURL, bytes.NewReader(antBody))
191		if err != nil {
192			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "failed to build upstream request", "internal_error")
193			return
194		}
195		antReq.Header.Set("content-type", "application/json")
196		antReq.Header.Set("x-api-key", backend.APIKey)
197		antReq.Header.Set("anthropic-version", "2023-06-01")
198	
199		resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(antReq)
200		if err != nil {
201			g.log.Error("anthropic upstream error", "backend", backendName, "error", err)
202			writeError(w, http.StatusBadGateway, "server_error", "upstream error: "+err.Error(), "upstream_error")
203			return
204		}
205		defer resp.Body.Close()
206	
207		if resp.StatusCode/100 != 2 {
208			var buf bytes.Buffer
209			buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
210			writeError(w, resp.StatusCode, "server_error", "upstream: "+strings.TrimSpace(buf.String()), "upstream_error")
211			return
212		}
213	
214		if meta.Stream {
215			w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
216			w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-cache")
217			w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
218			anthropic.TranslateStream(resp.Body, w, backendName)
219			return
220		}
221	
222		var buf bytes.Buffer
223		buf.ReadFrom(resp.Body) //nolint:errcheck
224		translated, err := anthropic.TranslateResponse(buf.Bytes(), backendName)
225		if err != nil {
226			writeError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "server_error", "response translation failed: "+err.Error(), "internal_error")
227			return
228		}
229		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
230		w.Write(translated) //nolint:errcheck
231	}

234	func (g *Gateway) handleModels(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
235		type modelObj struct {
236			ID      string `json:"id"`
237			Object  string `json:"object"`
238			Created int64  `json:"created"`
239			OwnedBy string `json:"owned_by"`
240		}
241		type modelsResp struct {
242			Object string     `json:"object"`
243			Data   []modelObj `json:"data"`
244		}
245	
246		var (
247			mu   sync.Mutex
248			data []modelObj
249			wg   sync.WaitGroup
250		)
251		now := time.Now().Unix()
252	
253		for name := range g.cfg.Backends {
254			name := name
255			wg.Add(1)
256			go func() {
257				defer wg.Done()
258				fallback := modelObj{ID: name, Object: "model", Created: now, OwnedBy: "wire"}
259	
260				addr, ok := g.mgr.Addr(name)
261				if !ok {
262					mu.Lock()
263					data = append(data, fallback)
264					mu.Unlock()
265					return
266				}
267	
268				ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), 5*time.Second)
269				defer cancel()
270	
271				req, err := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, http.MethodGet, addr+"/v1/models", nil)
272				if err != nil {
273					mu.Lock()
274					data = append(data, fallback)
275					mu.Unlock()
276					return
277				}
278	
279				resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
280				if err != nil {
281					mu.Lock()
282					data = append(data, fallback)
283					mu.Unlock()
284					return
285				}
286				defer resp.Body.Close()
287	
288				var mr modelsResp
289				if err := json.NewDecoder(resp.Body).Decode(&mr); err != nil || len(mr.Data) == 0 {
290					mu.Lock()
291					data = append(data, fallback)
292					mu.Unlock()
293					return
294				}

296				entry := mr.Data[0]
297				entry.ID = name
298				mu.Lock()
299				data = append(data, entry)
300				mu.Unlock()
301			}()
302		}
303		wg.Wait()

305		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")

309	// handleHealth returns 200 if at least one backend is healthy, 503 otherwise.
310	func (g *Gateway) handleHealth(w http.ResponseWriter, _ *http.Request) {

323	// buildReplacer creates a strings.Replacer that rewrites llama-server model name aliases
324	// in response bodies to the canonical backend name.
325	func (g *Gateway) buildReplacer(backendName string) *strings.Replacer {
326		aliases := g.rt.backendAliases[backendName]
327		var pairs []string
328		for _, alias := range aliases {
329			if alias == backendName {
330				continue
331			}
332			pairs = append(pairs,
333				`"model":"`+alias+`"`, `"model":"`+backendName+`"`,
334			)
335		}
336		if len(pairs) == 0 {
337			return nil
338		}
339		return strings.NewReplacer(pairs...)
340	}

342	// replacingReader wraps an io.Reader and applies a strings.Replacer to each chunk read.
343	// Overflow bytes (when replacement expands the chunk) are buffered internally.
344	type replacingReader struct {
345		r    io.Reader
346		repl *strings.Replacer
347		buf  bytes.Buffer
348	}
349	
350	func (rr *replacingReader) Read(p []byte) (int, error) {
351		if rr.buf.Len() > 0 {
352			return rr.buf.Read(p)
353		}
354		tmp := make([]byte, len(p))
355		n, readErr := rr.r.Read(tmp)
356		if n > 0 {
357			replaced := []byte(rr.repl.Replace(string(tmp[:n])))
358			copy(p, replaced)
359			if len(replaced) > len(p) {
360				rr.buf.Write(replaced[len(p):])
361				return len(p), nil // defer readErr until buf is drained
362			}
363			return len(replaced), readErr
364		}
365		return 0, readErr
366	}

371		w.WriteHeader(status)
372		json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]any{ //nolint:errcheck
373			"error": map[string]any{
374				"message": message,
375				"type":    errType,
376				"code":    code,
